$comment: Digest fields scripts/validate_output_schemas.py accepts although they break agent-contracts orange-palette/digest_form_v1 (bare hex, or a digest under a non-digest name). Each entry: a file name glob, a JSON path regex (paths look like /a/b[]/c; serials become <serial>, 64-hex path segments <hex>), and the reason. The list only shrinks for Orange's own families: remove entries when their family converts. Family G (foreign documents Orange copies verbatim) stays until the owner renames its fields; Orange never rewrites another system's document to satisfy this rule.

Spatial-mask source digest (family C): an empty string while the mask mode is off; an active policy (the 2026-08-25 GUI recordings) carries a sha256: token, required by orange.analytics.spatial_mask_runtime v1 and validate_policy.
Spatial-mask source digest in the geometry contract (family C): an empty string while the mask mode is off; a sha256: token when active (orange.analytics.spatial_mask_runtime v1).
Crop importance-map source digest in the crop recorder summary and supervisor plan, bare hex (family D).
SHAMAN v2 recording identity token: a sha256 token under its fixed wire-field name (shaman-ipc Slot.recording_identity_token); renaming needs a SHAMAN layout change (family E).

Citrus's citrus.runtime_rig_canvas_commissioning_compatibility v1 status block, copied verbatim from the Citrus control-socket response (src/gui/recording_snapshots.cpp update_gui_citrus_runtime_geometry_snapshot). Citrus names these *_fingerprint and already writes sha256: tokens (Citrus src/runtime/calibration_canvas_compatibility.h); only the field names break the rule, and renaming them is Citrus's change (family G, foreign verbatim copy).
Calibration and geometry artifacts name digests *checksum* with a separate checksum_algorithm field (image sets, homography/scale pointers, geometry assets manifest and contract copies) (family F).
